item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera collects four pure substances in her school science lab in Jaipur. She checks what kind of particles each substance is made of.

Which substance should she classify as an element?

options.A: distilled water, made of identical molecules each containing hydrogen and oxygen atoms
options.B: oxygen gas from a cylinder, made of identical molecules each containing only oxygen atoms
options.C: salt solution prepared by dissolving salt in water
options.D: sugar crystals, made of molecules containing carbon, hydrogen and oxygen atoms
